tldr: Chiron transiting the 5th house: a long healing chapter around creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy.
body: Chiron moving through the 5th house can reopen old material around creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is in creativity, romance, and play; a fear that what you make or who you love is not enough.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy. You free others to create and love without performing.
shadow: Withholding your creative or romantic self to avoid judgment.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 5th house deliberately. Work with creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
